prompt: Museum catalogue photo of a single object: a medieval iron axe head WITHOUT any wooden haft, 14th century Estonian peasant woodsman's axe, seen from the side showing one flat cheek of the head. Hand-forged wrought iron, dull grey-black, faint hammer marks, few small brown rust spots, steel-welded edge slightly brighter. No beard, no hook, no ornament, not Viking, not fantasy. Lying flat, poll on the left, edge on the right, whole object in frame with margin, plain pure white background, soft even studio light, no cast shadow, no text.
